comments.author: Wsp
comments.body: Boston research building 3. I have tested this by not carrying any supplies on 3 runs. No fires occurred but sailors still stole a few spice on my run. Can effectively replace using veils/fire prevention aide or ship skill. Reminder, boston research requires you to be in the corresponding job to be used.

comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
Just come here to say, even after equipped this skill, the fire CAN still happened. BUT, the message will say "Due of the Spice Trader Specific Effect, loss of Trade Cargo in the Cargo has been avoided!" so none of the spices lost after i checked again.

EDIT : Also, good for dealing with storm because this apparently also completely protected your cargo from falling while sailing in stormy seas.
